implementation.link_format: Web links use same-origin /channels/message routes; native shells preserve the packaged document URL and use the HashRouter fragment.
implementation.entry_points: Desktop context menus and mobile long-press sheets both copy the navigable URL with success and failure feedback.
implementation.navigation: Authenticated deep links open the correct channel or DM window through the existing authorized around-message APIs, arm scroll-to-message only after the target loads, and replace the transient URL.
implementation.privacy: The client does not embed message content in URLs. Inaccessible or deleted targets rely on the existing participant/channel authorization and expose no payload.

remaining_acceptance: Paste one channel and one DM link between two real clients, verify cross-server switching and centered scrolling, then verify a non-member receives only the generic unavailable result.
live_ui_verification: Local IAB opened /channels/message/dm/not-a-channel/not-a-message, replaced the URL with /channels and displayed only the generic Turkish unavailable toast; no message payload was exposed.
